name: Music Bot
description: Plays YouTube, SoundCloud and radio in voice channels: queue, playlists (TR Mix, EDM and your own), chat commands (!play, !list, !skip…). Opens from the music icon at the bottom left.
details:
Brings a music bot to your voice channel. Type a song name or a YouTube / SoundCloud link and the bot joins the channel and plays it. Every voice channel has its own queue, so two channels on the same server can listen to different music.

Window: while in a voice channel, click the music icon at the bottom left. The current song, progress bar, pause / skip / stop, volume and the queue are there. A small "now playing" strip also shows above your user panel.

Playlists: every server has its own playlists. TR Mix and EDM come ready, and you can create as many as you like. "Play" adds 20 shuffled songs from the list to the queue. Only the person who created a playlist or a server admin can edit it.

Chat commands (whoever types the command must be in a voice channel of that server): !play <song>, !list <name>, !trmix, !pause, !resume, !skip, !stop, !vol <0-100>, !queue, !np. Type !music for all commands. Turkish aliases work too (!çal, !liste, !devam, !kuyruk, !müzik).

When nobody is left in the channel, the bot leaves on its own after a minute.
